text:
Ingrid (Acct Mgmt): Heads-up — BrightGrid (acct: BRIGHT-01) invoice INV-5842 failed 3x this morning. Customer opened support ticket #9421 and asked for manual wire instructions if the card won't clear.

Megan (FinOps): I pulled the payment events. Stripe shows `card_declined` with code `insufficient_funds` on the last_attempt. We have auto-retry enabled (immediate, +24h, +72h). @Sam (Billing) @Raj (Payments Ops) — any objections to preparing a wire fallback now?

Sam (Billing): No objection. I retried once at 08:15, it failed again. Given customer says treasury is out today, wire sounds like the fastest resolution. Will draft instructions.

Ivy (Support): Customer replied: treasury will be back tomorrow but they prefer to wire today to avoid license disruption. Can we share bank details? Please redact full account numbers in Slack.

Megan (FinOps): Agreed — do NOT paste full account numbers here. Use secure upload or our payments portal.

Raj (Payments Ops): I'll create a secure wire instruction PDF and upload to our secure drive. Note: ACH would need micro-deposits (48–72h) so wire is the correct fallback. I'll also schedule a final automated retry 30 minutes from now as per policy.

Ingrid (Acct Mgmt): Customer specifically asked to reference "INV-5842 / BRIGHT-01" on wire remittance. Make sure that's in the instructions.

Sam (Billing): Drafting now. Template snippet (redacted):
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference LLC
Bank: First National Bank
ABA: 111000XXX (redacted)
SWIFT: FNBBUS33XXX
Account: ****1234 (last4)
Reference: INV-5842 / BRIGHT-01
```
I'll upload full PDF to secure://payments/wires once finalized.

billing-bot: Note added to invoice INV-5842: "3 failed CC attempts; wire fallback requested by customer (ticket 9421)."

Megan (FinOps): I'll mark the invoice status to `wire_pending` and turn off further auto-retries after the scheduled final attempt. Also set AR hold to avoid dunning emails.

Raj (Payments Ops): Uploaded: secure://payments/wires/brightgrid_INV-5842_redacted.pdf. Sent secure link to customer via support ticket. Last retry scheduled for 1768503099 (30m).

Ivy (Support): Customer confirmed they received the secure link and will initiate wire today. They'll notify when funds hit.

Megan (FinOps): Perfect. When payment clears: 1) mark invoice paid, 2) tag payment method = wire, 3) run usage reconciliation for Feb charges and issue any small-credit adjustments if needed.

Ingrid (Acct Mgmt): Thanks everyone. If the retry succeeds before wire, please still proceed with wire flow and cancel it if funds arrive to avoid duplicate payments.

Sam (Billing): Will monitor and update ticket 9421.

Raj (Payments Ops): FYI here's the webhook payload we saw (sanitized):
```json
{
  "id": "evt_1Jxxxxxx",
  "type": "invoice.payment_failed",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "in_1Hxxxxx",
      "customer": "cus_BrightGrid",
      "last_payment_error": {
        "code": "card_declined",
        "decline_code": "insufficient_funds",
        "payment_method": {
          "card": {
            "last4": "4242"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Ivy (Support): Updating the customer now. Will close the loop when payment is confirmed.

Megan (FinOps): Thanks — add any reconciliation notes to the invoice and ping me if we need to issue credits.

Ingrid (Acct Mgmt): Closing the thread for now. Will re-open if anything changes. :thumbsup:
